headline: the 20% reach number was measured with hard-coded coordinates. Reading geometry live from the live DOM gives 20/20 and 16/16 on two tasks that previously failed.

measurements.policy: read #query goal text, resolve the named option by its label element, click that radio, then re-read #subbtn geometry and click Submit
measurements.why_it_changed: #subbtn y position depends on option count: y=132 when n=3, y=150 when n=4, y=168 when n=5, y=186 when n=6 (core.randi(2,7) options). A fixed y=133 misses whenever n>3.

measurements.policy: read the goal sentence, exact-match a button by its accessible text, click it
measurements.attempts_before_the_fix: 0/16, all failures, because the START overlay is #sync-task-cover in this task, not #subbtn, so the episode never began

the_four_hardcoded_selectors_that_produc: clicking four fixed screen positions before pressing START (episode never began)
an ordinal radio index chosen by seed on a page that reshuffles options and changes their count every episode
a hard-coded Submit y=133 on a page where Submit is pushed down by the option list (y=132 to y=186)
a hard-coded #subbtn for the START overlay on a task that uses #sync-task-cover

revised_statement_about_reach.status_of_old_number: measured under a policy that used hard-coded coordinates/selectors; it understates what the same addressing channel reaches when geometry is read live
revised_statement_about_reach.new_number: NOT YET MEASURED AT SCALE. Two tasks measured at 20/20 and 16/16. A full 130-task sweep has not been run this round and no replacement percentage is claimed.
revised_statement_about_reach.honest_position: 2 tasks at 100% is not a 130-task rate. The only defensible claim is that two specific tasks the project previously failed are now solved reliably, and the cause of the earlier failures was addressing, not capability.

the_general_lesson: an agent that caches a coordinate is assuming a layout. MiniWob randomises option count, order and overlay id per task and per episode. Every cached address is a latent zero. Read geometry from the live DOM immediately before every action.
spectrum_module_status: repeat_execution_spectrum_v1 correctly reported NO_FAILURES_TO_ATTRIBUTE on both fully-solved tasks, and correctly localised an injected defect at ochiai 1.0 in the one design where a defect existed (r121d). It has never yet been shown to localise a NATURAL failure, because with live geometry the policy no longer produces any on these two tasks.
